label: Claude in Chrome
notes: The seven allow entries are the settled read-only set. Adding one is a security decision, not a convenience: every added tool is attack surface that the subagent's prompt-level tool grant would otherwise have refused.

Two prefixes, because the same server is reachable under two names: claude-in-chrome is the connected extension, Claude_Browser is the built-in pane. Both are stripped before the bare-name lookup, and a tool under any other server prefix is denied.

url_bearing lists the tools whose tool_input must carry a url. tabs_create_mcp is deliberately absent: it takes no parameters and opens a blank tab, so the url is checked on the navigate that follows it.

landing_check lists the tools whose response is scanned for an off-allowlist landing, and it is deliberately not the same set as allow. read_page and get_page_text return the page itself, which is full of third-party links; scanning those responses would block every read.
